_정본: 공방 계획 — 「무엇을 더 구울 것인가」의 목록. 지면(docs/공방/*.html)은 tools/공방지면.js 가 이 파일을 읽어 굽는다.
_왜: 유호 09-05 「다양한 요소가 필요한데 맨날 똑같은 코랄 요소나 진부한게 좀 있더라고 · 이왕 지금 가능할때 블렌더로 굽는것처럼 명품화작업을 마친 요소들을 많이 준비해두고싶어 · ppt나 앱이나 어느곳에서 전부 사용할수있는 느낌으로 하나하나 발전시켜나가면 좋을것같아」
_규율: 컨셉 정본 = 기억 felt-is-the-brand-concept — AI 가 흉내내기 어려운 펠트 재질, 보여지는 곳 전부, 퀄리티 높은 수작업 느낌
제미나이로 구운 것은 반드시 재염색을 거친다 — 모델이 낸 색은 브랜드 밖이다(09-05 실측: 크림을 시켰더니 #CEC0AE 베이지)
부품은 정사각으로 쓴다 — 칸이 가로로 길면 contain 이 세로에 맞춰 줄여 점이 된다
작은 크기에서 갈린다 — 44px·24px 실크기 줄이 진짜 자다

제미나이._왜 이쪽인가: 형태가 자유롭고 «사진»이어야 하는 것. 블렌더로 세우려면 형태 함수를 새로 짜야 해서 한 장에 몇 시간이 든다. 2K 한 장 190원 · 4K 336원.
제미나이._한도: 분당 요청 한도가 있다(09-05 실측: 넷째 장부터 429). 한 장씩 40초 사이를 둔다.

묶음.쓰는 곳: 지면 배경 · 카드 바탕 · PPT 표지

것들.지시: The cloth is densely needle-felted wool dyed a deep ink blue, the blue of a fountain pen on cold paper.
The cloth is densely needle-felted wool dyed a soft leaf green, the green of new grass in early spring.
The cloth is densely needle-felted wool dyed a warm pale yellow, the yellow of butter left out on a saucer.

것들.메모: 펠트 말고 다른 결이 한 벌 있어야 지면끼리 구분된다
것들.지시: The cloth is natural undyed linen canvas, oat coloured, its open plain weave loose enough to count the threads, slubs running irregularly through it.
The cloth is quilted cotton in warm cream, stitched in an even diamond grid, each diamond softly puffed between the stitch lines.
The cloth is cotton corduroy dyed a warm coral, fine even wales running in one direction, the pile catching light along every ridge.
A small five petal flower cut from wool felt in warm coral, the petals slightly overlapping, its centre a tight cluster of french knots in cream thread.
A single leaf shape cut from meadow green wool felt, one central vein hand stitched down its length in cream thread with small even stitches.
A small triangular pennant of butter yellow wool felt sewn onto a short pale wooden stick, the felt edge cut with a gentle wave.
A short strip of hand crocheted cream cotton lace with a scalloped edge, lying flat and slightly curved.
A quarter rosette ornament cut from wool felt in warm coral, its two straight edges meeting at a clean right angle, the curved edge scalloped and blanket stitched in cream thread.
A length of twisted cotton cord in warm coral tied into one simple overhand knot near the middle, both ends trailing loosely.

묶음.쓰는 곳: 「만드는 중」을 말하는 자리 · 공방 이야기 · 소셜
묶음._결: 펠트로 «만든» 장난감 도구가 아니라 «진짜 바느질 도구»다. 브랜드가 손수 만든 느낌이라 실물 도구가 이야기를 더 잘 한다 — 색만 브랜드 쪽으로 끌어온다.

것들.지시: A slender steel sewing needle threaded with a strand of warm coral wool yarn, lying at a slight diagonal, the yarn trailing away in one soft loose curve.
A small brass thimble with a finely dimpled surface, gently polished so the dimples catch the light, standing upright on its open end.
A pair of small sewing scissors with slender polished steel blades, the finger loops wrapped in warm coral wool felt, lying slightly open.
A round pincushion of densely felted wool in warm coral, with several dressmaker pins pushed into it at different angles, their small round glass heads in lapis blue and butter yellow.
A turned wooden spool wound with wool yarn in warm coral, the winding neat and even, one short tail of yarn escaping over the rim.
A short wooden ruler with fine engraved markings and a small triangular tailor's chalk lying beside it, the chalk a soft chalky blue.
A small globe made entirely of felted wool, the continents appliqued in meadow green onto a deep lapis blue ocean, one thin cream thread arcing across it between two hand stitched dots.
A passport sized booklet sewn from wool felt in deep lapis blue, a simple blank crest hand embroidered on the cover in butter yellow thread, a narrow felt ribbon marking a page.
A small closed book bound in warm coral wool felt, the stacked pages cream and slightly uneven, a thin cord bookmark escaping from the top.
Three small square blocks of felted wool stacked into rising steps, cream then butter yellow then warm coral, climbing from left to right.
A small window frame sewn from cream wool felt with four panes, a butter yellow felt curtain gathered to one side and tied with a cord.
A short thick arrow cut from wool felt in warm coral, pointing to the right, its edges hand stitched with a running stitch in cream thread.
Two short thick bars cut from wool felt in warm coral, crossing at their centres to form an X, each bar edge stitched in cream thread.
Three small round felted wool dots in warm coral, sitting in one evenly spaced horizontal row.
A small padlock shape cut from wool felt in warm coral, its shackle a separate arc of twisted cream cord passing through the top.
A small bell shape sewn from butter yellow wool felt, its edge blanket stitched in cream thread, a tiny cream felt clapper hanging below.
A short rounded capsule of wool felt in warm coral, its left portion a slightly raised meadow green felt band, like a progress meter sewn from cloth.

묶음._옮긴 이유: 유호 확정 09-05 「일단 당분간은 블렌더는 제미나이 없을때 사용하는거로 하자」 — 블렌더로 세우려면 형태 함수를 새로 짜야 해 한 종에 몇 시간이 든다. 제미나이는 문장 한 줄에 30초다.

블렌더._왜 이쪽인가: 재현이 필요하고 UI 에 정확히 앉아야 하는 것. 씨앗이 고정돼 언제든 같은 그림이 다시 나온다. 돈 0.
블렌더._한도: 한 장 2~3분 · 램 16GB 한 대 · 전량이면 8시간. 밤 배치로만 돌린다.

묶음._왜 안 굽나: 09-05 실측: 이미 구운 판에 `python tools/펠트색갈이.py <입력> <출력> --목표 "#색" --색상만` 을 걸면 돈 0원·한 장 3초로 색 갈래가 나온다. 굽는 일이 아니라 «후처리»다. 🔑 --색상만 을 반드시 준다 — 킷 색을 그대로 목표로 주면 원본보다 채도가 확 올라 쨍해진다(유호 지적 09-05 「너무 쨍한데? 잘 안보일정도야」).
